objective: Measure independent contribution of frozen local predictions to a public nested-OOF stack; do not probe leaderboard weights.
transform: Global average ranks -> (rank-0.5)/n -> logit; fixed convex blend of transformed scores.
tie_break: Among eligible candidates within 0.000002 pooled AUC of the best, prefer the smallest own weight.
output_policy: Generate candidates only if the fixed diagnostic gate passes. V5-based transfer is experimental because V5 has no true OOF counterpart.
limits: Historical OOF data were reused in previous development; this is exploratory development evidence, not untouched testing.
Public five-fold split and local three-fold split differ. Reporting by both partitions is a sensitivity check, not full nested retraining.
Local V3 trees used validation early stopping. Public stack OOF provenance is based on the source author.
Paired intervals condition on fixed predictions and do not account for model selection or dependence among CV-trained models.
The 0.95447 public-board-tuned V5 file cannot receive a valid local CV score from these files.
